message:
fix(tofu): read AKS OIDC issuer from infra-bootstrap remote state

Follow-up to #37, which switched the federated identity credential's
`issuer` to `data.azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.infra.oidc_issuer_url`.
That data source 404s because the cluster lives in subscription
606a1ca1 (romaine-life) while this stack authenticates against
aee0cbd2 (Azure subscription 1). Same failure mode diagrams/tofu hits.

Switch to reading `aks_oidc_issuer_url` from infra-bootstrap's tfstate
output instead. The tfstate blob is in this subscription's storage
account (nelsontofu) and the CI principal already has access to it
(that's where this stack's own state lives). Matches glimmung's
pattern in glimmung/tofu/remote-state.tf, which has been working.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
